nodes.label: Versioned human-readable DAS scripts
nodes.description: DAS scripts and canonical keymap support review, versioning and sharing through DAS Hotkey Tools.
nodes.rationale: Reviewing, versioning and sharing scripts is easier than editing Hotkey.htk directly.

nodes.label: DAS Hotkey Tools VS Code extension
nodes.description: External extension builds canonical keymap and script sources into generated output.htk.

nodes.label: Documented compilation and installation workflow
nodes.description: Build through DAS: Build Hotkey File; output.htk is generated and uncommitted. Timer installation remains manual.

nodes.label: SIM/LIVE placeholder substitution
nodes.description: Extension replaces %%SIMULATED%% and %%LIVE%%; manual copies require explicit replacement and actual TRSIM/LIVEACT identifiers.

nodes.label: DAS runtime and named window requirements
nodes.description: Requires Primary_OE, Primary_Chart, Timer Event Script, and advanced AccountObj.GetPosition/NewUserObj support; docs name DAS 5.8.4.4 as target.

nodes.label: In-memory regression versus DAS qualification
nodes.description: trade-isolation.test.cjs models script decisions only; it neither connects to DAS nor validates broker execution.

nodes.label: Exit coordinator rollback installation procedure
nodes.description: Docs prescribe flat/no-working-orders installation, complete timer replacement, restart, globals initialization and a 10-share SIM full-exit check.

nodes.label: Restored exit paths retain overlap risk
nodes.description: Rapid repeated exit presses can overlap; cancellation settling waits do not establish broker acknowledgment.

nodes.label: Four configurable entry tiers and quantity multiplier
nodes.description: Default tiers 100/200/300/500 times qtyMult 1.0; presets 0.5/1/1.5/2/3; maxPositionSize follows rounded Tier 4.

nodes.label: Profitable scale-in and total planned-stop risk gate
nodes.description: Long adds require at least 1R profit, use scale-in breakeven, and evaluate net planned-stop risk on the combined position.
nodes.rationale: Adds are allowed only when the thesis is working and combined planned-stop risk stays bounded.

nodes.label: Independent signed Bid and Ask entry offsets
nodes.description: Buy variants add offsets; Ask-/Bid- short variants subtract them. Defaults BID +0.01 and ASK -0.01.

nodes.label: Trade identity is account plus symbol
nodes.description: Runtime automation and cancellations are scoped to the original account/symbol across montage changes.

nodes.label: Client-side trade registry lifecycle
nodes.description: Configuration reload preserves initialized trade objects but resets settings/action lease. DAS restart clears the registry; existing broker orders are not reconstructed.
nodes.rationale: Configuration reload should not erase active trade state, while a restart requires deliberate restoration of protection.

nodes.label: Fresh signed account-position reads
nodes.description: Signed account Share includes reserved shares. Missing off-montage data is unknown; matching montage fallback is used only when required.
nodes.rationale: Native montage positions can be absolute or temporarily zero while shares are reserved; unknown data must fail closed.

nodes.label: Nested action lease and deferred automation
nodes.description: Lease pauses timer during waits, defers per-trade alerts and queues GTFO for its saved identity; interrupted lease expires after 30 seconds.

nodes.label: Timer-based long entry protection staging
nodes.description: Default useTimerArming=1 returns after send; actual fills arm protection. Existing SELLs/scale-ins require cancellation staging; no-fill timeout cancels buys.
nodes.rationale: Protection waits for real fills and valid average cost to avoid protecting a nonexistent or changing partial position.

nodes.label: Inline polling and per-trade entry cooldown
nodes.description: useTimerArming=0 polls actual fills; whole-second cooldown defaults to one second, handles midnight and does not delay stop arming.

nodes.label: Timer-owned partial-exit fill and cancellation stages
nodes.description: Half/quarter sells and TP return after submission. Timer confirms actual fills/residual closure, refreshes positions and restores protection; GTFO/full exits/cancel interrupt.
nodes.rationale: Releasing the action lease after send improves responsiveness while actual fills and cancellation closure determine remaining protection.

nodes.label: Automatic protection for actual short fills
nodes.description: Enabled stops and TP arm after actual short fills; cover completion and old BUY-stop cancellation acknowledgment precede replacement using fresh signed size.

nodes.label: Direction-aware fixed-R STOP/SLP protection
nodes.description: Long trigger AvgCost-R; short AvgCost+R; stop limit uses uncapped exitOffset. Fixed R defaults 0.50 with 0.10/0.20/0.30/0.50 presets.

nodes.label: Client-side R-target take-profit alerts
nodes.description: Long/short targets use AvgCost plus/minus R*factor; default partial is 50%. DAS timer/data must remain running; targets must be positive and profitable.

nodes.label: Generation, direction and revision protect TP lifecycle
nodes.description: TP payloads bind account/symbol/generation/direction/revision; stale payloads cannot act on replacement trades and consumed revisions cannot duplicate submission.
nodes.rationale: Stale or deferred alert payloads must not affect another trade, side or reset revision.

nodes.label: Entry spread, slippage, size and risk guards
nodes.description: Pre-send guards check spread versus R, planned-stop margin, maximum size and projected net risk. These apply in SIM and LIVE.

nodes.label: One tracked automated long per account by default
nodes.description: Manual shorts do not consume the guard. Same-account pending long staging blocks another entry; unknown position data retains the lock.

nodes.label: Rehab entry throttle
nodes.description: Rehab restricts LIVE to MIB/IB and prevents scale-ins; SIM participation is optional. Disabling rehab requires typed YES.

nodes.label: Optional oversized-position emergency exit and lock
nodes.description: Disabled by default. Enabled timer check on Primary_OE exits directionally, locks montage order buttons and blocks buys; montage unlock remains manual.

nodes.label: SIM opt-in for enabled live-only guards
nodes.description: applyLiveGuardsToSim defaults to zero; only enabled hijack/rehab guards become active in SIM when set to one.

nodes.label: AUTOL route-selection mode
nodes.description: Expected adding selects ARCA1L; taking selects BESTL at $1+, SMRTL when price*0.0036>0.0015 below $1, otherwise BESTL. Urgent exits use BESTL.

nodes.label: Quote-based adding/taking prediction
nodes.description: Final rounded limit versus opposite quote predicts liquidity; taking bands use opposite-quote expected price. Classification and eventual execution remain unproven.

nodes.label: AUTOL has no fallback, retry or session gating
nodes.description: Operator monitors documented 04:00-20:00 ET availability. Required missing quotes block ordinary AUTOL; STOP orders retain STOP route.

nodes.label: Independent percentage-capped GTFO cushion
nodes.description: Full signed exit uses min(0.50, quote*gtfoOffsetMaxPct), default 5%; manual route uses gtfoRoute and AUTOL overrides to BESTL.

nodes.label: Percentage ceiling on ordinary Bid- sells and Ask+ covers
nodes.description: Ordinary cushion is min(exitOffset,quote*exitOffsetMaxPct), default 0.10 and 5%; rounding stays inside ceiling. Stop-limit and hijack offsets are uncapped.

nodes.label: Momo-coordinated two-montage symbol swap
nodes.description: Fixed Ctrl+Shift+F12 internal script updates Primary/Secondary montages, charts and secondary tape. Momo checks flat/pending/setup; required live qualification is incomplete.

nodes.label: Stream Deck controls and DAS settings synchronization
nodes.description: LOAD CFG resets defaults and button states together. Direct globals edits/initializer do not synchronize displays. Physical and Virtual profiles mirror controls.

nodes.label: Conflicting manual-short protection descriptions
nodes.description: Manual-short introductory paragraph says no stops/TP/timer state, while overview and detailed STOP/TP sections explicitly describe automatic short protection.

nodes.label: Proposed pre-trade dollar exposure guard
nodes.description: Future candidate computes intended shares*price, optionally existing exposure, and blocks before submission.
nodes.status: future candidate, not implemented by this TODO

nodes.label: Proposed time-window trading lock
nodes.description: Future candidate uses GetSecond session boundaries and a Timer Event-updated TRADE_OK to block entries outside windows.
nodes.status: future candidate, not implemented by this TODO

nodes.label: Proposed loss-streak and cooldown guard
nodes.description: Future candidate tags stop intent to count stop-outs; discretionary exits/scratches excluded; entry cooldown must always permit exits.
nodes.status: future candidate, not implemented by this TODO
nodes.rationale: DAS cannot natively distinguish stop exits from manual exits; intent tagging is required.

nodes.label: Proposed session profit giveback lock
nodes.description: Future candidate internally tracks P&L and peak, blocks new entries after at least 50% peak giveback after target, with no live same-day auto reset.
nodes.status: future candidate, not implemented by this TODO
nodes.rationale: The TODO states script-safe realized P&L is unavailable, so proposed tracking must use globals.

nodes.label: Green Bid and red Ask offset microchip backgrounds
nodes.description: Icons preserve black interior and chip geometry, use exact green #00FF00/red #FF0000, and are downscaled to 156x160; plugin draws labels separately.

Source-only DAS hotkey workflow
nodes.rationale: The user compiles and installs hotkeys; compilation, loading, and active configuration changes require an explicit request.

nodes.label: Graphify query-first investigation workflow
nodes.rationale: Existing graph queries scope source inspection; missing or unavailable graph access has fallback paths so authorized work can continue.

nodes.label: Graph vocabulary and path direction rules
nodes.rationale: Expand unfamiliar wording against actual graph labels and use undirected paths intentionally; a missing directed path does not disprove a relationship.

nodes.label: Current-source verification of graph claims
nodes.rationale: Verify changed source and current line locations because a matching commit or stale graph claim does not establish current evidence.

nodes.label: Pending-refresh accounting requirement
nodes.rationale: Check pending-refresh.json and clear entries only after actual re-extraction and merging.

nodes.label: Graph and regression evidence limitations
nodes.rationale: Preserve extraction confidence distinctions; undirected paths do not prove runtime reachability and regression results do not prove installed DAS behavior or fills.

nodes.label: DAS-aware extraction and merge requirement
nodes.rationale: The standard parser does not recognize DAS files; refreshes require DAS adapter output, fresh test extraction, current semantic results, and preservation of unrelated evidence.

nodes.label: Retained-evidence builder limitation
nodes.rationale: The project builder renders retained extraction evidence and does not extract or merge new DAS output automatically.

nodes.label: Refresh integrity and provenance requirements
nodes.rationale: Preserve source locations and parallel-edge evidence, update manifest/cache only for processed files, and disclose stale scope and unavailable token usage.

nodes.label: Graph maintenance operational boundary
nodes.rationale: Graph maintenance does not authorize compiling or installing hotkeys, modifying Stream Deck profiles, or operating the trading application.
